summary: Iteration 4 (Razorpay-disabled build). Extended backend pytest suite from 11 to 20 tests — all pass. New tests cover: Razorpay config returns enabled=false with empty key_id, Razorpay order + verify both return 503 when disabled, PATCH /api/bookings/{id}/status handles all four statuses for admin, returns 422 for invalid status, 400 for malformed id, 404 for missing id, 403 for non-admin. /api/bookings/me confirmed to sort newest-first and expose payment_status/payment_id/razorpay_order_id fields. No regressions in prior auth/booking flows. Frontend Playwright verified: hero shows cropped team image (/assets/images/team-crop.jpg), signed-out visit to /my-bookings redirects home, signed-out /admin shows 'Admins only', register-from-modal stays on home and shows user pill, user-pill dropdown shows menu-my-bookings for customer (no menu-admin), booking from home displays booking-confirmation modal with 'call to confirm' copy and NO Pay Now button (Razorpay disabled — correct graceful fallback), /my-bookings lists the just-created booking card, non-admin at /admin sees zero admin rows, admin login exposes menu-admin, /admin renders all 5 stat cards (stat-requested/confirmed/completed/paid/revenue), admin-search-input + admin-status-filter present, 14 admin-row-<id> present, inline status change on a row persists to DB (verified by reload+refetch).

issues: Navbar on /admin collapses to only a 'Sign out' link — user-pill dropdown with My Bookings is not accessible from admin page. Consider keeping the full user pill or adding a link back to /my-bookings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still reads CORS_ORIGINS env but ignores it (dead branch L451-454) — remove or actually honor multiple origins.

create_booking() manually calls get_current_user() and swallows HTTPException. Consider a dedicated optional_user dependency; also today an *expired/invalid* cookie is silently treated as anonymous, which is fine but worth documenting.
razorpay_client is constructed at import time; if keys are rotated the process must be restarted. Acceptable for MVP.
PATCH /bookings/{id}/status has no audit/history — future enhancement.
AdminDashboard fetches all bookings with limit 500 and no pagination — flag for scale.
test_credentials: admin@gngwar.com / Admin@GngWar2026 (seeded, verified). New TEST_<uuid>@test.com customers created per run.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run and the UI flow create TEST_ prefixed users + Home Cleaning / Sweeping+Mopping bookings. No cleanup performed (safe — prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test IDs verified: menu-my-bookings, menu-admin, navbar-user-pill (aliased user-pill-toggle), booking-confirmation, pay-now-button (absent when Razorpay disabled — correct), stat-requested/confirmed/completed/paid/revenue, admin-search-input, admin-status-filter, admin-row-<id>, admin-status-<id>, booking-card-<id>. When Razorpay is enabled later, add tests for: /order returns key_id + amount + order_id for a valid booking; /verify accepts a manually-signed HMAC and flips booking to paid+confirmed. The 401s in the console during initial page load are just /api/auth/me probing while signed-out — expected.
